vibe: Objective, rigid, functional, bureaucratic, cold, official, satirical

rules.headings: Chivo or IBM Plex Sans, ALWAYS UPPERCASE, tracking-tight, font-black.
rules.body: IBM Plex Mono or Space Mono for forms, labels, and text to give a typewriter/bureaucratic feel.

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black uppercase tracking-tighter
scale.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold uppercase tracking-tight

spacing_and_layout.grid: Strict grid hierarchy. Mode B: 'Control Room' grid. Dense, data-heavy, full utilization.
spacing_and_layout.borders: Heavy use of 1px and 2px solid black borders (border-stone-900). Grid borders on containers.
spacing_and_layout.padding: Generous internal padding for forms (p-6, p-8) but sharp, square corners (rounded-none).
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Left-aligned content. No center-aligned text unless it's a specific 'stamp' or 'seal'.

surfaces_and_components.buttons: Brutalist. Flat black background, white text. Or transparent with thick black border. Hover: invert colors or solid red. No rounded corners (rounded-none).
surfaces_and_components.inputs: Flat, bottom border only or full sharp 1px border. Background matches paper. No shadow.
surfaces_and_components.cards: Dossier style. 2px black border, solid paper background. Often with an uppercase label in the top-left.
surfaces_and_components.stamps: Use red or green text with a rotated, thick border to simulate physical stamps ('APPROVED', 'CLASS IV INCIDENT').
surfaces_and_components.modals: Harsh modal overlays. bg-black/80 with a pure white/stone-100 central modal, thick black borders, stark close button.

animations.general: Restrained, mechanical. No bouncy easing. Use linear or step-like animations.
animations.processing_ritual: Terminal typing effect, scanlines, blinking cursors. Phrases appearing one by one with a mechanical delay (e.g., 'Analyzing moral debt...', 'Cross-referencing existential dread...', 'Calculating karma deficit...').

images.description: Ministry of Karma Cleanse official bureaucratic seal

landing_page.elements: Header with seal, large h1 'KARMA CLEANSE v2.1', live flipping counter for 'Incidents Processed', 'Begin Karma Cleansing' brutalist CTA.

identity_registry.elements: Form asking for 'Legal Name' with an alternative 'Remain Anonymous' button. Input fields look like paper forms.

incident_declaration.elements: Large textarea for 'Incident Report'. Rotating placeholders like 'I took the last coffee without brewing a new pot...', 'I ghosted my therapist...'. Character counter. Submit button.

processing_ritual.elements: Animation screen (4-8s). Progress bar filling up mechanically. Sequences of bureaucratic text.

severity_classification.elements: Result dossier. Red stamp 'CLASS III SEVERITY'. Risk score chart (use simple horizontal bars). Protocol required.

protocol_selection.elements: Two cards side by side. 'Temporary Absolution' (Free, expires in 24h) vs 'Certified Absolution' (Premium, permanent).

certificate_display.elements: Final printable certificate. Contains user ID, incident hash, severity, QR code (mocked SVG), seal image. Share and Download buttons.

technical_instructions.frameworks: React, TailwindCSS, Framer Motion (for processing animations).
technical_instructions.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='begin-cleansing-btn').
technical_instructions.accessibility: High contrast ratio guaranteed by black on off-white. ARIA labels on forms.
